column1: # Per okderators-catalog-index branch: what catalog-edit.sh (MODE=catalog) changes, and which
# installed CSVs the graph walk starts from. Tab-separated, one row per branch; lists are
# comma-separated CSV names. A row holding TO-FILL stops a catalog run before any edit.
#   REMOVE     the alpha channel's entries before the edit, exactly; their entries and bundle
#   INSTALLED  CSVs a cluster may run; {DATE} is the new bundle's DATE, {DATE-1d}/{DATE+1d} a day
#              earlier/later: a test-shaped CSV (our test build) and the official 4.21 build; release-4.22
#              also names the 4.21 test build this cluster ran before the 4.22 hop (2026-10-27)
# release-4.21 and release-4.22: the plan's Global Constraints (2026-10-23). release-4.20: Task 1's
# reading of upstream release-4.20 (pins.md section 3, 2026-10-23): the head is the only entry.
